title: Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1990

sections.shortTitle: Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1990
ACT V OF 1990
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act to amend the Sindh
Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th July, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-1/90, dated
16-7-1990: -The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment)
Bill, 1990 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June,
1990 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th July, 1990 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Insertion of section 5-A in Sindh Act XXVI of 1974

ACT V OF 1990
ACT V OF 1990
ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act to amend the Sindh
Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th July, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-1/90, dated
16-7-1990: -The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment)
Bill, 1990 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th June,
1990 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th July, 1990 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
4. Insertion of section 5-A in Sindh Act XXVI of 1974.--In the said
Act, after section 5, the following new section shall be inserted:--
"5-A. Free
Traveling.-(1) A member shall be provided during a year with such vouchers of
the value of twenty-five thousand rupees as would enable him to travel within
Pakistan at any time without payment of any fare by Air or by Rail:
Provided that,
where a person becomes a Member during the course of a year, the value of
vouchers with which he is provided during that year shall be reduced
proportionately. -
(2) A member
who does not wish to be provided with the vouchers shall be paid an allowance
of twenty thousand rupees in lieu of, such vouchers.
(3) Any
voucher with which a Member is provided under subsection (1) may be utilized by
the family of the Member.
(4) The
utilization by a Member of any voucher with which he is provided under
subsection (1) for the purpose of any journey for which he is entitled to any
travelling allowance under this Act shall not in any way effect his right to
receive such allowance.
Explanation.- For the purpose of this
section, "family" means the spouse and children and
"Member" includes the Speaker, the Deputy Speaker, a Minister, an
Advisor to the Chief Minister, a Special Assistant to the Chief Minister, a
Parliamentary Secretary and Leader of Opposition."

maintenance allowance.-- A Member shall be entitled to receive office
maintenance allowance at the rate of one thousand and five hundred rupees per
month."
